name: Abdul Wahid.
tagline: Based in Lahore, I combine technical project management with applied AI to build open-source computer vision software that helps researchers automate complex healthcare, agricultural, and facial stress diagnostics.
bio: I'm an Applied AI and Computer Vision Engineer based in Lahore, passionate about turning complex machine learning research into practical tools for healthcare, agriculture, and digital media. As a hands-on developer and technical project manager, I build high-impact systems—from medical diagnostic pipelines and crop analysis models to live-call AI assistants that provide real-time intelligence. Holding an MSc in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Essex, I back my open-source portfolio with academic rigor, ensuring my work is well-documented and accessible via GitHub and ORCID
